llm_response.reason: The website exhibits multiple scam characteristics: (1) Promises unrealistic and guaranteed high ROI (up to 80%), (2) Uses urgency tactics such as instant withdrawals and referral bonuses, (3) Focuses on cryptocurrency deposits and withdrawals—typical in investment fraud, (4) Company details and history are ambiguous, with no verifiable information, (5) Customer 'testimonials' have no verification and feature fake-style endorsements, (6) Privacy policy and business transparency are unclear, (7) WHOIS lookup did not disclose any real ownership or business data. All these match general investment scam profiles.
